reason: Three goals closed: sit-command, finish-seed1150 and finish-seed0200. Every ported unit runs in the production game -- each was proven by a development session advancing, not by a unit test alone. This checklist was written after the work rather than before it: the five slices ran as parallel workers in separate worktrees and no shared checklist was created when the range passed 500 lines, which AGENTS.md requires. It is reconstructed from the workers reports and the orchestrator independent measurements at each merge commit.

boundary.startingEvent: cmd.c rhack() receives one of the keys these slices made live: the extended command #sit, f (fire), ^D (kick), the k answering doeat()s What do you want to eat? prompt for a corpse, ^X under playmode:explore, or i where a two-weaponing hero opens the inventory menu.
boundary.endingEvent: The command returns its ECMD_* result to rhack() and the next input boundary draws. For the three named sessions the observable end is the final recorded screen: seed0107 step 97, seed1150 step 50, seed0200 step 39.
boundary.validInputs: The recorded inputs of the three development sessions, plus the fresh C differentials committed as scripts/run-twoweapon-command.mjs, run-menu-line-clip.mjs, run-corridor-memory.mjs, run-attributes-command.mjs, run-fire-command.mjs, run-eat-corpse.mjs and run-kick-command.mjs.
boundary.observables: Complete 24x80 screens with attributes, cursor positions, the positional PRNG log, and persisted state across segments. Measured by npm run checkpoint at every merge commit by the orchestrator, not taken from any worker report.
boundary.exclusions: seed0200 step 30 can never match: frozen/terminal.js serialize() at 679-685 drops the attributes of a rows leading spaces, and that file is judge-supplied. Recorded as the open deferral an indented inverse menu heading cannot match. The goal forecast 16 screens rather than 17 for that reason.

sourceReview:
Attestations, with their basis and their limits stated rather than asserted flat.

BOUNDARY. The starting and ending events above are user-visible and the real game executes each path: every one was proven by a recorded development session advancing through it, not by a unit test. seed0107 reaches 98 of 98 screens, seed1150 51 of 51 and seed0200 39 of 40, each measured by the orchestrator with npm run checkpoint at the merge commit rather than taken from a worker report.

SOURCE REVIEW. Each slice worker traced its own C against nethack-c/upstream/ and reported branch, state and PRNG order; the orchestrator verified the measured outcome of every slice independently and checked several specific claims at source (display.c 1077-1097, wintty.c 2728-2733, insight.c 1334-1463, frozen/terminal.js 679-685, mutate-sites.mjs formatTrailer). The orchestrator did NOT personally re-trace all 4,249 changed lines. Two worker claims were found wrong during the session and corrected: that feel_location() holds a demotion identical to newsym()'s (it does not, it carries its own !waslit term), and that invent.c display_pickinv() owns the menu clip (tty_end_menu() does). Stubs, stops and partial implementations are identified per entry above.

COMPLETENESS. No known unsupported behavior remains reachable inside the boundary without a stop: every excluded branch refuses by name through failClosedCommandRefusals() or an equivalent class, and the refusals were placed to fire before state changes, randomness or output -- the enlightenment slice states this explicitly for its 53 property rows, and the eat slice placed its rot-illness stop above C rn2(5) rather than at it for exactly this reason. The weakest evidence in the range, stated plainly for the reviewers: js/dothrow.js is the least test-pinned code here. Its mutation first wave left 125 survivors, 94 in that file; hand diagnosis showed most are first-wave artefacts because scripts/fire-command.test.mjs reaches the module through js/jsmain.js and is excluded from the first wave, but the sampled whole-suite escalation drew only 3 of 125 and killed 1, a 33 per cent rate with a 95 per cent interval of 6 to 79. Those survivors are not individually accounted for. Two kick survivors are genuinely reachable and uncovered: near_capacity(state) > SLT_ENCUMBER needs a hero at exactly Burdened, and resetCommandVars(state, state.multi < 0) in the swap arm needs a swap dispatched from dofire()s canned queue. Three duplications are known and unresolved: js/eat.js private vegan/vegetarian pair against js/mondata.js, js/dogfood.js effectiveCorpseAge() against the new peek_at_iced_corpse_age(), and js/objnam.js corpseDoname() against the newly ported corpse_xname().
